articles.title_en: The Old Boys' Club: Schmoozing and the Gender Gap
articles.title_cn: 老男孩俱乐部：社交与性别差距
articles.abstract_en: Offices are social places. Employees and managers take breaks together and talk about family and hobbies. In this study, we show that employees' social interactions with their managers can be advantageous for their careers, and that this phenomenon contributes to the gender pay gap. We use administrative and survey data from a large financial institution and exploit quasi-random variation induced by the rotation of managers. We provide evidence that when employees have more face-to-face interactions with their managers, they are promoted at a higher rate. This mechanism could explain a third of the gender gap in promotions at this firm.
articles.abstract_cn: 办公室是社交场所。员工和管理人员一起休息，谈论家庭和爱好。在本研究中，我们表明员工与管理人员的社交互动可能对其职业有利，并且这一现象导致了性别薪酬差距。我们使用一家大型金融机构的行政和调查数据，并利用管理人员轮换引起的准随机变化。我们提供的证据表明，当员工与管理人员有更多面对面的互动时，他们获得晋升的比率更高。这一机制可以解释该公司晋升性别差距的三分之一。

articles.title_en: Optimal Monetary Policy According to HANK
articles.title_cn: 根据HANK模型的最优货币政策
articles.abstract_en: We study optimal monetary policy in an analytically tractable heterogeneous agent New Keynesian model with rich cross-sectional heterogeneity. Optimal policy differs from a representative agent benchmark because monetary policy can affect consumption inequality, by stabilizing consumption risk arising from both idiosyncratic shocks and unequal exposures to aggregate shocks. The trade-off between consumption inequality, productive efficiency, and price stability is summarized in a simple linear-quadratic problem yielding interpretable target criteria. Stabilizing consumption inequality requires putting some weight on stabilizing the level of output, and correspondingly reducing the weights on the output gap and price level relative to the representative agent benchmark.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个具有丰富横截面异质性的可解析处理的异质代理人新凯恩斯模型中的最优货币政策。最优政策不同于代表性代理人基准，因为货币政策可以通过稳定由异质性冲击和总冲击的不平等暴露引起的消费风险来影响消费不平等。消费不平等、生产效率与价格稳定之间的权衡被概括为一个简单的线性二次问题，从而产生可解释的目标标准。稳定消费不平等需要对稳定产出水平赋予一定权重，并相应减少相对于代表性代理人基准的产出缺口和价格水平的权重。

articles.title_cn: 美元定价下的最优政策
articles.abstract_en: Empirical evidence shows that most international prices are sticky in dollars. This paper studies the policy implications of this fact in the context of an open economy model with general preferences, technologies, asset markets, nominal rigidities, and a rich set of shocks. We show that although monetary policy is less efficient and cannot implement the flexible-price allocation, inflation targeting and a floating exchange rate remain robustly optimal in non-US economies. The capital controls cannot unilaterally improve the allocation and are useful only when coordinated across countries. International cooperation benefits other economies, but is not in the self-interest of the United States.
articles.abstract_cn: 经验证据表明，大多数国际价格以美元计价具有粘性。本文在具有一般偏好、技术、资产市场、名义刚性和丰富冲击集的开放经济模型背景下，研究了这一事实的政策含义。我们表明，尽管货币政策效率较低且无法实现弹性价格配置，但在非美国经济体中，通胀目标制和浮动汇率制仍然稳健地是最优的。资本管制不能单方面改善配置，只有在各国协调时才有用。国际合作有利于其他经济体，但不符合美国的自身利益。

articles.title_en: Evidence and Lessons on the Health Impacts of Public Health Funding from the Fight against HIV/AIDS
articles.title_cn: 公共健康资金对健康影响的证据与教训：来自抗击艾滋病毒/艾滋病的经验
articles.abstract_en: HIV/AIDS has been one of the largest public health crises in recent history, and the US federal government has spent hundreds of billions of dollars fighting the disease. This study examines the impact of the large amounts of federal funding allocated to US cities to combat HIV/AIDS through the Ryan White CARE Act's first title. The findings indicate that the cost to avoid an HIV/AIDS death through the program is roughly $334,000, that the program has saved approximately 57,000 lives through 2018, and that funding disparities are responsible for the uneven progress in combating HIV/AIDS across the United States.
articles.abstract_cn: 艾滋病毒/艾滋病是近代历史上最大的公共卫生危机之一，美国联邦政府已花费数千亿美元用于抗击该疾病。本研究考察了通过《瑞安·怀特关怀法案》第一标题分配给美国各城市的大量联邦资金对抗击艾滋病毒/艾滋病的影响。研究结果表明，通过该计划避免一例艾滋病毒/艾滋病死亡的成本约为334,000美元，该计划到2018年已挽救了约57,000人的生命，并且资金分配不均是美国各地抗击艾滋病毒/艾滋病进展不均衡的原因。

articles.title_en: Heroes and Villains: The Effects of Heroism on Autocratic Values and Nazi Collaboration in France
articles.title_cn: 英雄与恶棍：英雄主义对法国专制价值观及纳粹合作的影响
articles.abstract_en: We measure how a network of heroes can legitimize and diffuse extreme political behaviors. We exploit newly declassified intelligence files, novel voting data, and regimental histories to show that home municipalities of French line regiments arbitrarily rotated under Philippe Petain's generalship through the heroic World War I battlefield of Verdun diverge politically thereafter, particularly following Petain's own overt espousal of authoritarian views. Further, under Petain's collaborationist Vichy regime (1940–1944), they raise 7 percent more active Nazi collaborators per capita. These effects extend across all forms of Nazi collaboration and diffuse beyond the veterans themselves.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们衡量英雄网络如何合法化并扩散极端政治行为。我们利用新解密的军事情报文件、新颖的投票数据以及团史资料，表明在菲利普·贝当将军指挥下，法国步兵团通过第一次世界大战凡尔登英雄战场任意轮换的家乡市镇，在政治上此后出现分化，特别是在贝当本人公开拥护威权观点之后。此外，在贝当的维希合作政权（1940-1944年）下，这些市镇的人均活跃纳粹合作者数量增加了7%。这些影响扩展到所有形式的纳粹合作，并扩散到退伍军人本身之外。

articles.title_en: Confidence, Self-Selection, and Bias in the Aggregate
articles.title_cn: 信心、自我选择与总体中的偏差
articles.abstract_en: The influence of behavioral biases on aggregate outcomes depends in part on self-selection: whether rational people opt more strongly into aggregate interactions than biased individuals. In betting market, auction and committee experiments, we document that some errors are strongly reduced through self-selection, while others are not affected at all or even amplified. A large part of this variation is explained by differences in the relationship between confidence and performance. In some tasks, they are positively correlated, such that self-selection attenuates errors. In other tasks, rational and biased people are equally confident, such that self-selection has no effects on aggregate quantities.
articles.abstract_cn: 行为偏差对总体结果的影响部分取决于自我选择：理性人是否比有偏差的个体更强烈地选择参与总体互动。在博彩市场、拍卖和委员会实验中，我们记录了某些错误通过自我选择被大幅减少，而其他错误则完全不受影响甚至被放大。这种差异的很大一部分可以通过信心与表现之间关系的差异来解释。在某些任务中，它们呈正相关，因此自我选择会减弱错误。在其他任务中，理性人和有偏差的人同样自信，因此自我选择对总体数量没有影响。

articles.title_cn: 扭曲信念下的审慎政策
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies leverage regulation when equity investors and/or creditors have distorted beliefs relative to a planner. We characterize how the optimal regulation responds to arbitrary changes in investors'/creditors' beliefs, relating our results to practical scenarios. We show that the optimal regulation depends on the type and magnitude of such changes. Optimism by investors calls for looser leverage regulation, while optimism by creditors, or jointly by both investors/creditors, calls for tighter leverage regulation. Our results apply to environments with (i) planners with imperfect knowledge of investors'/creditors' beliefs, (ii) monetary policy, (iii) bailouts and pecuniary externalities, and (iv) endogenous beliefs.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当股权投资者和/或债权人相对于计划者持有扭曲信念时的杠杆监管。我们刻画了最优监管如何应对投资者/债权人信念的任意变化，并将我们的结果与实际情景联系起来。我们表明，最优监管取决于此类变化的类型和幅度。投资者的乐观情绪要求放松杠杆监管，而债权人的乐观情绪，或投资者/债权人共同的乐观情绪，则要求收紧杠杆监管。我们的结果适用于以下环境：（i）计划者对投资者/债权人信念了解不完善，（ii）货币政策，（iii）救助和金钱外部性，以及（iv）内生信念。

articles.title_en: The Value of Working Conditions in the United States and the Implications for the Structure of Wages
articles.title_cn: 美国工作条件的价值及其对工资结构的影响
articles.abstract_en: We document variation in working conditions in the United States, present estimates of how workers value these conditions, and assess the impact of working conditions on estimates of wage inequality. We conduct a series of stated-preference experiments to estimate workers' willingness to pay for a broad set of working conditions, which we validate with actual job choices. We find that working conditions vary substantially, play a significant role in job choice, and are central components of the compensation received by workers. We find that accounting for differences in preferences for working conditions often exacerbates wage differentials and intensifies measures of wage inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了美国工作条件的差异，提出了工人如何评价这些条件的估计，并评估了工作条件对工资不平等估计的影响。我们进行了一系列陈述性偏好实验，以估计工人对广泛工作条件的支付意愿，并通过实际工作选择进行了验证。我们发现工作条件差异显著，在工作选择中扮演重要角色，并且是工人获得补偿的核心组成部分。我们发现，考虑工作条件偏好的差异往往会加剧工资差异，并强化工资不平等的度量。
